companyDescription: Advanced nuclear (fast-fission microreactors) · Aurora powerhouse at INL (now guided 2028–2029) · Groves-1 test reactor reached criticality · fuel fabrication + recycling + isotopes · $3.1B cash after $2.3B of 2026 ATM sales
priceNote: Live $20.77 (+4.63%, Nov 23 close, Yahoo). About 81% below the $111.65 52-week high, ~58% below the 200-day (~$49.06) and just above the $19.20 52-week low. It set new lows in early November despite a +22.7% Q3 day (Nov 6).
summary: The best-funded name in advanced nuclear, now priced near its lows. Oklo holds $3.1B of cash and securities, its Groves-1 test reactor reached criticality in under a year, and it has 2027 milestones lined up: first full fuel assembly, a recycling pilot, Groves-2 and its first isotope delivery. The headwinds are real. The first Aurora plant slipped to 2028–2029, there was a PJM setback, a new $1B ATM is open, and the average analyst target fell to $65 from $105 (B. Riley $61, Wedbush $36). There is no binary event before the Q4 print (~Mar 2027). Base +55% is a 6–12 month recovery toward the 50-day (~$30), above the turbo P75 (21.5%). It ranks #5 on survival only. แนะนำ 1–2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — dilution ต่อเนื่อง ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 45%+.

catalysts.name: Q4 2026 results / 2027 milestone update
catalysts.description: Next scheduled update on the Aurora-INL construction timeline (now 2028–2029), Groves-2 start and fuel-fabrication progress. No date announced.

catalysts.name: First full fuel assembly + recycling pilot
catalysts.description: Management's 2027 targets: first full fuel assembly at its fabrication facility and commissioning a recycling pilot, alongside the first contracted isotope delivery. Timing depends on approvals.

risks: Timeline slip: the first Aurora plant at INL is now guided to 2028–2029 and an analyst questioned even that on the Q3 call; the NRC permit path has no timeline.
Dilution: $2.3B was raised through ATM sales in the first three quarters of 2026 and a new $1.0B ATM opened Sep 11; analysts estimate ~$6.3B of FCF burn in 2026–2030, about 2x current cash.
PJM setback (Q3) and no binding power-purchase revenue yet; the initial customer is expected to be the national laboratories.
Target cuts: B. Riley $92→$61 (Oct 28), Wedbush assumed at $36 (from $110); the average target fell to $65 from $105.
Macro WAIT (15/100); AI-power names were a core part of the Nov unwind.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00%. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~91% (Nov 23); futures dropped the 50bp tail after the November selloff.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct core CPI +0.3% m/m (hot). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y; Oct PCE (Nov 25) consensus 3.2% is the last inflation print before the Fed.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Advanced nuclear is the longest-duration trade on the board: first revenue is years out, so every rate hike lowers the present value of 2028+ cash flows. The cash pile removes near-term survival risk but not dilution risk.
macroRisk.summary: HIGH — /macro is WAIT (15/100, high conviction): S&P 7,237 is still below its 200-day (~7,340) after the Nov 23 +4.7% squeeze, VIX 27, breadth ~43% above 50DMA, HY OAS widening to ~3.52%. Turbo prior is unproven in this regime (0/107 windows had SPY down >2%).

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · ค่าขนม 1–2% max — $3.1B cash but the Aurora timeline slipped and dilution continues. The turbo at-catalyst median is -6.6% (n=76), so Entry 2 ($18.00–19.50) is preferred; this is the weakest of the five on headwinds.

catalystSpot.preRunup: OKLO trades on AI-power sentiment and DOE/NRC headlines more than dated events.

postWin.note: OKLO rose 22.7% on Nov 6, 2026 (Q3 + Groves-1 criticality); in 2025 it ran from ~$20 to ~$190 on the AI-power trade.

postLose.note: OKLO fell 31.2% in November 2025 and 14% in a week (Oct 27–Nov 3, 2026) with no company news.

spotSizing.reason: 1.5%. regulatory_approval sits at +5.8pp vs +7.7pp overall (n=23), below average but not a laggard. Headwinds (Aurora slip, $1B ATM) and macro WAIT cut size below the 2% floor of the other four.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the turbo medianMAE (-20%). A break of the 52-week low with no bounce means the nuclear bid is gone.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If Q4 pushes Aurora past 2029 or the ATM accelerates below $20, exit.

Riley $61, Wedbush $36) ไม่มี event binary ก่อนงบ Q4 (~มี.ค. 2027) Base +55% เป็นการฟื้นกลับหาเส้น 50 วัน (~$30) ในกรอบ 6–12 เดือน สูงกว่า P75 ของ turbo (21.5%) ติดอันดับ 5 เพราะความอยู่รอดเท่านั้น แนะนำ 1–2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — dilution ต่อเนื่อง ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 45%+

risks: ไทม์ไลน์เลื่อน: Aurora แห่งแรกที่ INL ตอนนี้ guide ปี 2028–2029 และนักวิเคราะห์ยังตั้งคำถามกับไทม์ไลน์นี้ใน call Q3 เส้นทางใบอนุญาต NRC ยังไม่มีกำหนด
Dilution: ระดมทุนผ่าน ATM $2.3B ใน 3 ไตรมาสแรกของปี 2026 และเปิด ATM ใหม่ $1.0B เมื่อ 11 ก.ย. นักวิเคราะห์ประเมินการเผาเงิน FCF ~$6.3B ช่วงปี 2026–2030 ราว 2 เท่าของเงินสดปัจจุบัน
อุปสรรคกับ PJM (Q3) และยังไม่มีรายได้จากสัญญาซื้อไฟที่ผูกพัน ลูกค้ารายแรกคาดว่าเป็นห้องปฏิบัติการแห่งชาติ
การลดเป้า: B. Riley $92→$61 (28 ต.ค.) Wedbush เริ่มใหม่ที่ $36 (จาก $110) เป้าเฉลี่ยลดเป็น $65 จาก $105
